N.name: Coonhound
N.reason: AKC/UKC group evidence establishes seven distinct coonhound breeds and variable characters. No separate eighth identity; suppress broad ranking card, preserve useful group text as historical authoring.

N.name: Coydog
N.reason: Coydog denotes domestic dog–coyote hybrids, not a distinct domestic breed or regional type. Current exact evidence is one sanctuary animal, which cannot establish population-level character or identity. Preserve ID/history; reopening requires an explicitly authorized broader product scope and defensible population evidence, not another individual anecdote.

N.name: Dorkie
N.reason: Sissy/Winston/Lana and other keeper anecdotes; Kellys independently opened page concerns its eight-week sale puppies, not mature type evidence

N.name: Elkhound
N.reason: NKK elghund activity family explicitly nine breeds including Laikas; FCI black/grey standards differ. English generic singular also shorthand for Norwegian Grey. Suppress ambiguous multi-breed grouping.

N.name: Foxhound
N.reason: MFHA notebook pages98/102/104 confirms common working selection and four American/English/Penn-Marydel/Crossbred branches. Valid grouping but no independent morphology; specific breeds available. Suppress redundant broad ranking card; England-only origin unsuitable for combined scope.

N.name: German Pointer
N.reason: Four independent German pointer standards support member-scoped traits; generic German Pointer is also used for GSP shorthand. Ambiguous collection, suppress rather than choose a new identity.

N.name: Hound
N.reason: AKC hound group explicitly warns generalizations limited; copy contrasts Beagle/Whippet correctly. Extremely broad collection overlapping specific entries, suppress.

N.name: Lhasalier
N.reason: Belle one-year keeper submission and Lily Reddit appearance; generalized company/play exceeds one-dog observations

N.name: Mountain Dog
N.reason: FCI section2.2 spans diverse separate molossoid mountain-type breeds incl Newfoundland/Hovawart; Swiss family separately classified. Generic English identity underdetermined and redundant, suppress.

N.name: Munsterlander Pointer
N.reason: German Large breed club expressly denies Large being larger version of Small; Austrian joint regulations describe two breeds, not third identity. Summary correctly acknowledges this but broad shared name adds no distinct ranking object, suppress.

N.name: Pinscher
N.reason: FCI section1.1 and184/185/186 support member-scoped claims, but plain Pinscher often means German breed; additional broad card is ambiguous/redundant. Suppress.

N.name: Pomeranian-Chow Chow Mix
N.reason: Luna classified and Foxy memorial; generalized companion character exceeds those animals

N.name: Pug-Labrador Retriever Mix
N.reason: Brandi rescue, Taz daycare and Chico sitting account; parentage does not validate whole-cross character

N.name: Retriever
N.reason: AKC Retriever account supports biddability, soft carrying and distinct breeds including independent Curly. Correct synthesis but redundant collection with misleading single representative. Suppress.

N.name: Setter
N.reason: AKC Setter account explicitly four distinct breeds, bird scenting and historic crouch/net; correct summary but English portrait cannot represent a new fifth breed/type. Suppress redundant group.

N.name: Sheepdog
N.reason: Sheepdog is a broad functional group with many distinct herding breeds and regional types; not one coherent selectable population.

N.name: Spaniel
N.reason: AKC broad family spans toy and sporting branches; copy correctly scopes work to flushing subset. Generic spaniel spans incompatible tasks/morphologies; suppress redundant broad card.

N.name: Spitz
N.reason: AKC describes Spitz as imprecise broad category; FCI Samoyed permits full resting tail down. Not a portrait defect, but class cannot establish distinct identity. Suppress.

N.name: Sporgi
N.reason: Chloe in one author’s successive accounts, not independent observations of the Sporgi population

N.name: Springer Spaniel
N.reason: FCI125/126 and AKC history support two distinct English/Welsh breeds; no independent third Springer. Suppress redundant umbrella; specific English/Welsh cards provide better exact identity.

N.name: Swiss Mountain Dog
N.reason: AKC Sennenhunde/four FCI standards show four separate breeds with differing characters. Existing member identities suffice; suppress generic group, do not equate it with Great Swiss only.

N.name: Terrier
N.reason: AKC/FCI broad terrier group supports general work history but exact Border is just one member. Broad group duplicates many cards and cannot be ranked consistently as one type. Suppress.

N.name: Water Dog
N.reason: FCI group8 section3 plus exact member standards support diverse water-work history and modern truffle specialization. Administrative collection does not establish new type, suppress.

N.name: Water Spaniel
N.reason: FCI124/301 support separate Irish/American characters and water retrieval, older land/water division genuine. New generic card adds no distinct type beyond leaf breeds, suppress.

N.name: Wauzer
N.reason: Elvis pet-shop origin story and Lola clinical case; behavior is not a Wauzer population description

N.name: Weimardoodle
N.reason: Laika, an owner submission; no cross-wide observations

N.name: Wolfdog
N.reason: Broad Wolfdog label covers heterogeneous domestic/wild crosses and sanctuary populations, not a distinct domestic breed or regional type. Specific evidenced domestic breeds with historical wolf ancestry remain eligible.

N.name: Yorkie Russell
N.reason: Baxter adult submission plus commercial Yorkie Russell puppy litter descriptions; whole-cross adult claims exceed those scopes
